title: Data Scientist (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Commissariat du Gouvernement à la souveraineté des données Missions Le Commissariat du gouvernement à la souveraineté des données (« CGSD ») est une administration dont les missions sont prévues par la loi du décembre . Le CGSD peut être désigné par les administrations et les communes comme délégué à la protection des données (DPO) ou assister les DPO internes que les administrations étatiques ont désignés. Il est l'organisme compétent, conformément à l'article 7, paragraphe 1er du règlement (UE) / (règlement sur la gouvernance des données), habilité à octroyer ou à refuser l'accès à certaines données protégées du secteur public et leur réutilisation. Il a également pour mission de contribuer au développement de la protection des données et de dispenser des conseils en matier/ière de gouvernance des données et de l'intelligence artificielle au sein des administrations étatiques. Il conseille, sur demande, les membres du Gouvernement pour une mise en œuvre cohérente des politiques en ces matier/ières. Enfin dans le cadre de ses missions de conseil et guidance, le CGSD sensibilise les agents publics et développe des documents et des outils adaptés visant à assister les entités en matier/ière de conformité au RGPD. Dans ce cadre, et pour renforcer le Département Autorité luxermbourgeoise des données, le CGSD recherche deux (2) Data Scientists expérimenté(e)s en matier/ière de Privacy et PETs (Privacy-Enhancing Technologies). En ce sens, il faudra pour les personnes qui candidatent être en capacité de satisfaire aux missions ci-après exposées : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions avancées en science des données, avec un focus particulier sur la protection de la vie privée et les technologies d'amélioration de la confidentialité (PETs); Analyser et modéliser des données complexes, développer des algorithmes de machine learning et évaluer leur performance; Identifier et mitiger les risques liés à la confidentialité et à la réidentification dans les projets data et IA, Contribuer à la définition de standards et bonnes pratiques en matier/ière d'anonymisation, pseudonymisation et gestion des données sensibles; Collaborer avec les équipes métier et techniques pour intégrer les contraintes de privacy dans les pipelines de données et les modèles IA; Réaliser des analyses approfondies de qualité des données, de lignée et de conformité privacy; Assurer une veille scientifique et technique sur les avancées en privacy engineering et en techniques d'anonymisation. Profil Compétences techniques Les candidat(e)s devront faire preuve d'un véritable niveau d'expertise, à savoir: Expertise Data: Expertise poussée en modélisation de données, data lineage, data quality et data governance; Maîtrise des environnements Big Data, bases relationnelles et NoSQL, ainsi que des outils de traitement de données massives; Solides compétences en SQL avancé et en raisonnement sur les structures de données complexes; Expérience dans la gestion et la transformation de données sensibles dans des environnements réglementés; Expertise solide sur les standards et modèles de données de (OMOP CDM, OpenEHR, FHIR, HL7). Expertise IA: Maîtrise des techniques de Machine Learning et d'Advanced Analytics (clustering, Random Forest, Boosting, réseaux de neurones, NLP, etc.); Expertise approfondie en Privacy Enhancing Technologies (k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, differential privacy, agrégation, suppression, généralisation, etc.); Expérience dans l'évaluation de modèles, la conception de suites de tests et l'analyse des limites des algorithmes; Connaissance des modèles de langage et des outils d'IA générative appliqués à des cas d'usage privacy et confidentialité. Compétences comportementales Analyser : Vous évaluez les informations, données et contenus de manier/ière critique, le cas échéant dans un environnement digital, vous identifiez les liens logiques et restituez l'information dans une synthèse complète et cohérente; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez...

title: Expert , développement informatique (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? En tant qu'expert , vous participerez activement au développement de logiciels. Dans ce contexte, vous serez sous la responsabilité directe du Release Manager de l'ADEM. En tant qu'Expert , vous serez à même d'évaluer et de mettre en œuvre les meilleures pratiques de développement dans le cadre de la migration des systèmes « legacy » (Java/Struts2), tout en garantissant la qualité des livrables. Votre capacité à intégrer de nouvelles technologies sera cruciale pour maintenir notre nouvel environnement et répondre aux besoins évolutifs de nos clients. Dans ce cadre, vous contribuerez activement à l'intégration de solutions d'IA générative et d'automatisation intelligente au sein des processus métiers de l'ADEM. Votre rôle inclura l'évaluation, le prototypage et la mise en œuvre d'outils d'IA pour optimiser les services digitaux (ex : chatbots, traitement automatique de documents, analyse prédictive des données emploi). Vous collaborerez avec les équipes Data Science et les architectes pour garantir l'alignement des solutions IA avec les enjeux éthiques, réglementaires (RGPD) et techniques de l'agence. Vous jouerez également un rôle clé en tant que support technique lors des phases de pré-projet. La collaboration avec différentes équipes (développeurs, architectes, chefs de projet) sera indispensable. Votre expertise technique vous permettra d'identifier les meilleures pratiques de développement pour adapter et améliorer les services digitaux de l'ADEM. Missions Développement de logiciels : Concevoir, développer et maintenir des applications logicielles en fonction des besoins des projets; Participer à l'analyse technique des solutions, en collaboration avec les équipes projet; Accompagner les équipes de développement sur les meilleures pratiques de développement; Assurer la qualité du code et des livrables, via des revues de code, des tests en accord avec la politique générale de test déjà établie. Veille technologique : Analyser l'impact potentiel des nouvelles technologies sur l'ADEM et ses projets; Proposer des évolutions technologiques pertinentes pour l'amélioration continue des processus et des outils utilisés au sein de l'ADEM Intégration et développement de solutions IA : Répondre d'un point de vue technique à l'adoption de l'IA dans les projets de modernisation; Participer à la conception de modèles d'IA en respectant les principes FAIR (Fairness, Accountability, Transparency) et les réglementations (RGPD, AI Act); Participer à l'audit des biais algorithmiques et à la documentation des impacts (ex : fiches d'impact IA); Former, accompagner et sensibiliser les développeurs s aux bonnes pratiques de développement avec l'IA (ex : prompt engineering, fine-tuning, MLOps); Contribuer à la rédaction de guides internes sur l'utilisation sécurisée et responsable de l'IA. Profil Compétences techniques Maîtrise de plusieurs langages de programmation (Java, Groovy, Angular, Jsp, Struts2 etc.), des outils de gestion de versions (Git, SVN), et des environnements de développement (IDE, CI/CD, etc.); Maitrise des environnements Z/os et Websphere; Bonne connaissance des architectures SOA (essentiellement JAVA) ainsi que micro-services et des bases de données (DB2, PostgreSQL); Expérience concrète dans la conception ou l'intégration de solutions d'IA (ex : APIs de LLMs, pipelines de traitement de données, outils low-code/no-code); Maîtrise des frameworks IA et des outils MLOps; Connaissance des enjeux éthiques et juridiques liés à l'IA (ex : explicabilité, protection des données, conformité au EU AI Act), Expérience avec les plateformes cloud pour le déploiement de modèles d'IA; Soft skills : Esprit d'équipe, sens de la communication, capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes, autonomie, rigueur; Protection de données : Connaissance liée au RGPD pour assurer la conformité en matier/ière de protection des données personnelles; Sécurité de l'information : Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques en matier/ière de sécurité de l'information, notamment dans le cadre du développement sécurisé; Capacité de rédaction de documentation technique en lien avec les solutions développées. Compétences comportementales Esprit d'Analyse : Capacité à comprendre et à résoudre des problèmes complexes liés aux processus de développement logiciel; Autonomie : Capacité à travailler de manier/ière autonome tout en coordonnant efficacement avec différentes équipes et reporter au release manager; Communication : Excellentes compétences en communication pour assurer une collaboration fluide avec les équipes...

description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Atouts Vous avez une véritable expérience de Délégué à la protection des données au Luxembourg; Vous êtes titulaire du CCDL. title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. title: Valuation Manager (m/f)
description:
Description:


Job ID: 21500
Date posted: July 23 2026
Category: Real Assets
Job Level: Manager


ABOUT US:

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com  


YOUR FUTURE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead the valuation process for portfolio assets and oversee the preparation and review of valuations for each NAV calculation, ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance with applicable valuation standards and internal policies;
Drive the valuation assessment of new investment opportunities, providing independent challenge and expert judgment on pricing assumptions, methodologies and transaction structures;
Perform and oversee detailed financial, operational and market analysis of portfolio assets and the sectors in which they operate, identifying key value drivers, risks and opportunities;
Prepare and review comprehensive valuation reports, presenting valuation conclusions, methodologies, key assumptions and sensitivities to senior management and governance bodies;
Present valuation analyses and recommendations to the Valuation Committee and actively contribute to valuation-related discussions and decision-making processes;
Act as a key point of contact for valuation matters, working closely with Portfolio Management, Fund Onboarding, Risk Management, Operations & Oversight, Finance and other internal stakeholders, as well as external parties including General Partners, investment advisors/managers, auditors, third-party valuation firms, service providers and regulators;
Monitor market developments, industry trends and regulatory changes affecting valuations, ensuring that valuation methodologies remain robust and aligned with best market practices;
Contribute to the continuous enhancement of valuation policies, procedures, controls and governance frameworks across the organization;
Support and mentor junior team members, fostering technical excellence and knowledge sharing within the valuation function.


YOUR PROFILE:

You hold a Master's degree (MA/MSc/MBA or equivalent) in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field;
You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years of direct valuation experience gained within asset management, advisory, valuation consulting, audit, private markets, or a similar environment;
You have strong knowledge of valuation methodologies applicable to alternative assets, including Private Equity, Real Estate and/or Infrastructure investments;
You possess a solid understanding of financial statements, financial modelling, investment analysis and valuation principles;
You demonstrate strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and exercise sound professional judgment;
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills and are comfortable presenting complex valuation topics to senior stakeholders and governance committees;
You are able to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders and confidently interact with asset managers, advisers and auditors on technical valuation matters;
You proactively stay informed about market developments, valuation best practices and regulatory requirements, assessing their impact on valuation processes and outcomes;
You have a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment;
You are fluent in English


WHAT WE OFFER:

We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.

Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.


Our global benefits also include:

Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
Continuous mentoring along your career progression
Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
Plus additional local benefits depending on your location
Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
description:
SENIOR FUND ACCOUNTING OFFICER

Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.
• Clear and confident communicator with internal teams and clients.
• Proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.

description:

Job ID: 10488709 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our goal is to exceed the expectations of all our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small are delivered where and when they need them, as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best in class service levels through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the last mile delivery space. Come join the team and help us make history!

Key job responsibilities

The role will own the re-engineering of the current automated forecasting model, Fleet Requirement Planning [FRP], to:
(1) integrate new Amazon organization van requirements (e.g. Ship With Amazon (SWA) /Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Lite);
(2) move to clustering, probability-based modelling and agentic AI;
(3) scale optimization models with objective function being the operational costs;
(4) evolve the user interface from Excel based to a more friendly dashboard;
(5) integrate new supply channels and netting logics within the model (e.g. van sharing, off-season vans, vehicle multi use etc.) to drive the related sourcing accordingly;
(6) integrate seamless both upstream and downstream (approvals) processes.
(7) scale Fleet Requirement Planning to Middle Mile
(8) supporting effectively critical business decisions (Capex/Opex, rental/lease/cross country transfer, vehicle type mix, asset utilization etc.) based on risk assessment and long term constraints. Visibility will be key for the success of the program.

For this purpose you will develop a “digital twin” of the FRP models where to perform “what if analysis”, multiple planning scenarios and investment analysis to define “alternative” demand and supply plans, in collaboration with Finance and other Stakeholder teams.

A day in the life

• Design and develop scalable Fleet demand modelling;
• Integrate closely with finance business partners to ensure plans are efficient and meet Peak demand, to ensure efficient ordering process
• Define and own Fleet Demand forecasting accuracy metric
• Be accountable for the timely “buy in” from VP/Senior Stakeholder about the significant Fleet CAPEX investment and OPEX decisions;
• Consolidate input from a different set of stakeholders and ensure fleet plans always consume the latest available assumptions;
• Drive the transition to electrification (EV planning Business As Usual) and integration of MoT into Fleet Requirement Planning;
• Extend FRP process to new business customer organization (SWA, DSP Lite) and countries to be launched over the next years;

title: Country Manager Nordics
description:
Our global team of over 10,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon.

Be part of the future of iGaming with 10,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary

    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.

title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
    Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently and taking ownership of allocated responsibilities.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters to us
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast and lunch prepared every day in our penthouse kitchen – you can save up to €3,000 a year
    Birthday leave – as we want you to celebrate your day
    Company and team-building events – trust us, these are legendary
    Relocation package to Malta, including a flight and two weeks of accommodation
    And much more – see for yourself!

Apply today and be part of our success story!

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Meet the criteria? Apply today and become part of the Immense Group journey.

NIOO has recently set the ambition to harmonise data collection and strengthen data management across the institute. This will support NIOO's Open Science ambitions as the national hub for ecology and forms part of the broader NIOO Open Data for Ecology (NODE) project.
Within NIOO, there is a vast number of small, fragmented datasets collected by numerous individual researchers in small projects. These data are often low-volume and heterogeneous in format and methodology, which is typical in the ecology and evolution domain (the so-called long tail of science).
To achieve this, we first need to understand which data practices are currently in use, how they relate to one another, and which overarching standards should be applied across the institute. What you will be doing
As Data Harmonisation Analyst you will be tasked with: - mapping the fragmented data landscape at NIOO - clustering the different datasets in terms of design, structure and use - identifying standards and open science practices relevant for each cluster
As Data Harmonisation Analyst you will contribute to: - setting up harmonisation protocols for existing datasets - the organisation of practical workshops and tutorials that can help individual researchers at NIOO with data management What you will be contributing

De uitdaging? Technisch talent is schaars. Veel organisaties vissen in dezelfde vijver en traditionele werving werkt steeds minder goed. Daarom zoeken wij iemand die verder kijkt. Train smart: follow your capacity, not just the physical activity guidelines Train slim
13 July
Ana Rodrigues
We all know that exercise is healthy. But how much exercise is actually enough? And do you always have to give it your all during every workout? The Dutch Physical Activity Guidelines provide a good starting point for this. For adults, the advice is to to exercise moderately intensely for at least 150 minutes per week, and to perform muscle- and bone-strengthening exercises at least twice a week. to do and limit prolonged sitting as much as possible. It is important to know that this no targets , but the minimum amount of exercise which is necessary to stay healthy.
However, in practice, we see that many people unconsciously deal with this in two ways. They either do too little because work, family, or other obligations always take precedence, or they deliberately try to perform at their maximum during every training session, even on days when their body is actually not ready for it. Listen to your body
No two days are the same. One day you feel energetic and strong, while on another you may have slept less well, be under a lot of stress, or simply feel more tired. That is precisely why it is important not only to follow a training schedule, but also to listen to your load capacity to check. A simple way to do this is to ask yourself one question before every training:
"How strong do I feel today? "
Give yourself a score of 0 to 10. - 8 to 10: Do you feel fit and energetic? Then feel free to challenge yourself a little extra. - 5 to 7: Great energy? Follow your normal training schedule. - 0 to 4: Low energy? Scale back the training slightl...

title: Author
description:
EMA Centralised Procedure - Analysis of Marketing Authorisation Applications
Author
Cornelis Jansma
Published on
April 29, 2026
The European Medicines Agency (EMA) focus group on submission predictability monitoring report (H2-25 MAAs pipeline monitoring exercise) makes one thing clear: predictability in Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAA) is improving, but industry still has significant room to mature.
Key findings include: - 57% of MAAs were submitted on time, up from 48% in 2023. - Short-notice delays remain a major issue: over 60% of applicants provided less than 60 days' advance warning before shifting their submission date. - Justifications for delays are often missing or uninformative; only 73% of applicants who changed their plans provided a justification, and many cited internal resource constraints or planning issues. - Generics and biosimilars frequently bypass timely Letters of Intent, creating additional unpredictability. - While communication between applicants and regulators has improved, the overall planning reliability remains insufficient to support efficient workload allocation across the EU regulatory network.
The report concludes that although progress is visible, predictability challenges continue to strain regulatory resources, and further improvements in applicant planning and transparency are essential. EMA will continue monitoring but will shift focus toward new approaches aligned with the upcoming New Pharmaceutical Legislation.
With the regulatory network under increasing workload pressure, companies that invest in predictable, well-governed submission processes will be better positioned for smooth assessments and timely approvals.

title: Helsefagarbeider Stjørdal helsehus
description:
Stjørdal Helsehus tilbyr en spennende og meningsfull arbeidsplass der pasientenes behov står i sentrum. Vi legger stor vekt på samarbeid, faglig utvikling og trivsel på jobb. Som helsefagarbeider hos oss vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver, utvikle kompetansen din og bidra til å gi våre pasienter trygg og helhetlig omsorg. Korttidsavdelingen i 2. etasje består av 19 senger, hvor 5 senger er avsatt til palliativ behandling, 2 senger er kommunal øyeblikkelig hjelp og 12 korttidssenger. I helsehuset finner du i tillegg en korttidsavdeling med 4 rehabiliteringssenger og flere korttids- og langtidssenger i 3. og 4. etasje. I helsehuset finner du også en fin kafe, Stjørdal DMS, Værnesregionen legevakt og Værnes respons.

Vi er et bredt sammensatt tverrfaglig team med lege, sykepleier, helsefagarbeider, fysioterapeut og ergoterapeut. 

Oppgi i søknaden hvilken stilling du søker på.

Vi har følgende faste stillinger ledige:

  • 2 x 100 % stilling som helsefagarbeider, med arbeid hver 3. helg
  • 1 x 55 % stilling som helsefagarbeider på natt

Oppgi i søknaden hvilken stilling du søker på.

Arbeidsoppgaver er blant annet:

  • Gi helhetlig pleie og oppfølging av pasienter
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid med kolleger og andre faggrupper
  • Dokumentasjon og faglig vurdering i journalsystem
  • Bidra til kvalitetsforbedring og utvikling av tjenestene
  • Veilede elever, lærlinger og kolleger ved behov
  • Samarbeid med pårørende og andre instanser
  • Observere, vurdere og iverksette nødvendige tiltak, samt evaluere behovet for den enkelte pasient

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Godkjent autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider
  • Krav om medisinkurs og har kompetanse på å håndtere medisinsk utstyr
  • Krav om god erfaring med pårørendearbeid og tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Utføre delegerte arbeidsoppgaver i tråd med rutiner og prosedyrer som gjelder for avdelingen

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Har erfaring og engasjement for kartlegging av tjenestebehov, medisinsk omsorg og palliasjon
  • Interesse for faglig utvikling og kontinuerlig forbedring
  • I stand til å arbeide selvstendig i krevende situasjoner som krever god vurderingsevne
  • Det er viktig at du er trygg på deg selv, og er godt kjent med ditt fag og din rolle
  • Tar ansvar, er glad i utfordringer og bidrar til godt arbeidsmiljø
  • God muntlig og skriftlig språkforståelse

Personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Faglig utvikling

  • En spennende arbeidsplass i kontinuerlig utvikling
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø
  • Du vil få ordnede betingelser, herunder lønns- og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldende avtaleverk

Andre opplysninger:

Søkere som ønsker å benytte seg av fortrinnsrett, må gjøre oss oppmerksom på det i søknaden. I samsvar med offentlighetsloven § 25 gjør vi oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan offentliggjøres, selv om det er bedt om konfidensiell behandling. Søkere vil i tilfelle bli forhåndsvarslet om dette.

Stjørdal kommune ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, og at våre ansatte skal gjenspeile befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn eller minoritetsbakgrunn.  


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stjørdal er en voksende bykommune som farges av et rikt idretts- og kulturliv, gode naturopplevelser og møteplasser som innbyr til fellesskap og mangfold. I Stjørdal er det godt å vokse opp og bo. Har du en drøm om et liv på landet, eller tiltrekkes du mest av det urbane? Vi legger til rette for at du skal kunne velge. Som kommune og arbeidsgiver har vi et viktig samfunnsoppdrag, og våre dyktige medarbeidere er nøkkelen for at vi skal kunne nå våre mål. Trivsel på arbeidsplassen, trygge og ordnede arbeidsforhold, god livsfasepolitikk og muligheter for personlig og faglig utvikling står derfor sentralt i vår arbeidsgiverpolitikk.

title: Seniorrådgiver teknologi
description:
Om stillingen

Hos Datatilsynet vil du få jobbe med noen av de fremste ressurspersonene i Norge på personvern. Du vil få mulighet til å spille en viktig rolle for personvernet i et stadig mer digitalt samfunn. Teknologene i Datatilsynet er en del av et spennende tverrfaglig miljø, og sammen med øvrige teknologer, jurister og samfunnsvitere vil du kunne være med å påvirke hvordan Datatilsynet skal jobbe og fremstå i framtiden. 

Stillingen er plassert i seksjonen for teknologi, sikkerhet og tilsyn (TST).

 Arbeidsoppgaver

  • delta i prosjekter i Datatilsynets sandkasse for digitalisering og innovasjon og KI-sandkassen som kommer som en del av KI-forordningen
  • delta i samarbeid med andre offentlige etater i tverretatlige prosjekter og samarbeid (NSM, NKOM, KI Norge med flere)
  • saksbehandling, hovedsakelig behandling av meldinger om brudd på personopplysningssikkerheten 
  • delta i tilsynsaktivitet med offentlige og private virksomheter
  • bidra til godt samarbeid mellom ulike profesjoner
  • bistå i interne prosjekter
  • veiledning, rådgivning, utarbeidelse av veiledningsmateriell og foredragsvirksomhet 

Kvalifikasjonskrav og personlige egenskaper

Kvalifikasjonskrav 

  • relevant høyere utdanning på universitets-/høgskolenivå fra studieretninger som ingeniørfag, informatikk, informasjonssikkerhet eller forvaltningsinformatikk 
  • meget god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk 
  • minst fem års relevant arbeidserfaring
  • god og oppdatert kunnskap om utfordringer, trender og løsninger innen teknologi 
  • spesialisert kunnskap om ett eller flere av følgende områder: personopplysningsloven, KI forordningen, rammeverk og standarder for informasjonssikkerhet, kunstig intelligens og algoritmer, systemutvikling og innebygd personvern, styringssystem for personvern og informasjonssikkerhet, hendelseshåndtering og risiko- og sårbarhetsvurderinger 
  • må kunne sikkerhetsklareres på nivå KONFIDENSIELT 

Personlige egenskaper

Du bør: 

  • ha gode analytiske evner 
  • være resultatorientert
  • ha stor arbeidskapasitet og gjennomføringsevne 
  • kunne samarbeide godt med ulike profesjoner 
  • kunne representere tilsynet på en god måte både i nasjonal og internasjonal sammenheng

 

Personlig egnethet vil vektlegges. 


Vi kan tilby deg
  • meningsfylte arbeidsoppgaver og et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • et sterkt fagmiljø med engasjerte medarbeidere
  • et inkluderende og trivelig arbeidsmiljø med kultur for kunnskapsdeling
  • fleksibel arbeidstid og mulighet for hjemmekontor
  • subsidiert treningsmedlemskap og mobiltelefonordning
  • lyse og moderne lokaler i Barcode i Oslo med subsidiert kantine 
  • gode pensjons-, forsikrings- og låneordninger gjennom Statens pensjonskasse
  • lønn i stillingskode 1364 Seniorrådgiver, i lønnsspennet 750 000-880 000 kr.
    Lønnsinnplassering avhenger av erfaring og kvalifikasjoner. For særlig godt kvalifiserte kandidater kan høyere lønn vurderes.

Kontaktinformasjon, søknadsfrist og offentlighet

Spørsmål om stillingen kan rettes til seksjonssjef Kristine Stenbro på telefon 944 25 055 eller e-post kst@datatilsynet.no. Alternativt fagdirektør Hallstein Husand, telefon 908 21 845, epost hallstein.husand@datatilsynet.no. 

Søknad med CV, karakterutskrift, vitnemål og attester sendes elektronisk via JobbNorge innen 06.09.2026. Søknader som mangler CV eller karakterutskrift vil ikke bli behandlet. For spørsmål om utfylling av CV, kan Jobbnorge kontaktes på telefonnummer 75 54 22 20.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at offentlig søkerliste vil bli gjort tilgjengelig for alle som spør om innsyn.


Mangfold

Vi ser på mangfold som en styrke for arbeidet vårt. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsvariasjoner, seksuell orientering, religion og etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi vil også gjerne gjøre oppmerksom på at når du søker jobb i staten og har funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn, kan du ha krav på positiv særbehandling dersom noen forutsetninger er oppfylt. Les om forutsetningene på Arbeidsgiverportalen. Vi tilrettelegger selvsagt så godt vi kan for medarbeidere som har behov for det. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Datatilsynet driver med tilsyn, saksbehandling, rådgivning og kommunikasjonsarbeid i skjæringspunktet mellom juss, teknologi og politikk. Vi spiller en nøkkelrolle i forhold som berører personvernet, og har som ambisjon å sette dagsorden og være en viktig premissgiver i personverndebatten.

title: Prosjektleiar- Samhandling for overgang frå utanforskap til arbeid
description:
Vil du vere med og utvikle betre samhandling mellom Nav, kommunane og opplæringsløp for å få fleire ut i arbeid og utdanning? Vi søkjer ein strukturert og målretta prosjektleiar som kan drive fram eit viktig utviklingsarbeid i kommunane Ørsta og Volda.

Prosjektstillinga skal bidra til betre samhandling og koordinering på tvers av Nav, kommunane og fylkeskommunen. Målet er å redusere utanforskap ved å rekruttere primært unge til arbeid i den kommunale helse og omsorgstenesta, og legge til rette for kompetanseutvikling for deltakarane i programmet. På sikt er målet å bidra til auka bemanning og ei meir berekraftig teneste.


Arbeidsoppgåver

Som prosjektleiar får du eit overordna ansvar for å utvikle, koordinere og følgje opp eit felles deltakarforløp. Du skal sikre framdrift, struktur og kvalitet – både på systemnivå og i oppfølging av den enkelte deltakar

Stillinga er i første omgong eit toårig engasjement, men det kan verte høve til lenging dersom føresetnadane for det ligg føre.

Prosjektleiar skal:

  • vere bindeledd mellom Nav, kommunar og opplæring
  • koordinere og sikre gode deltakarforløp
  • sikre framdrift, struktur og kvalitet i arbeidet
  • koordinere samarbeid på systemnivå
  • følgje opp progresjon i individuelle deltakarforløp
  • identifisere flaskehalsar og bidra til kontinuerleg forbetring
  • dokumentere effektar og resultat av arbeidet
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Vi søkjer deg som:
  • har relevant utdanning innan helse, sosialfag, HR, organisasjon eller tilsvarande. Høgare utdanning er ønskeleg, men kandidatar med annan relevant utdanning og erfaring vert også oppmoda til å søkje.
  • erfaring frå prosjektleiing eller utviklingsarbeid er ein fordel
  • har kjennskap til helse- og omsorgstenestene
Personlege eigenskapar

Vi ynskjer at du: 

  • er relasjonssterk og samlande og har gode samarbeids- og koordineringsevner
  • er gjennomføringskraftig
  • er analytisk og løysingsorientert
  • er tydeleg og arbeider strukturert og målretta

 

Vi gjer ei heilskapleg vurdering av søkjarane og personlege eigenskapar vert sterkt vektlagde. Referansar vert nytta og aktuelle søkjarar kan verte kalla inn til intervju.

Vi tilbyr
  • ei sentral rolle i utvikling av framtidas arbeidskraft
  • høve til å påverke samhandling på tvers av sektorar
  • spanande og meiningsfull prosjektstilling
  • eit tverrfagleg og utviklingsorientert miljø
  • utfordrande og varierte arbeidsoppgåver 
  • Gode forsikrings og pensjonsvilkår:
    Ørsta kommune har gode forsikringsordningar i KLP for sine tilsette, som også inkl. frivillig ulukkesforsikring  på fritida. 
    Som tilsett i Ørsta kommune får du del i ei av Noreg sine sikraste pensjonsordningar: offentleg tenestepensjon. Der dei fleste tenestepensjonar berre vert utbetalt i 10 år, er offentleg tenestepensjon ei utbetaling som varer frå den dagen du sluttar å jobbe og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre- og etterlattepensjon om noko uventa skulle skje.
    Som medlem i KLP får du i tillegg tilgong til ekstra gode vilkår på bank, forsikring og sparing.

 

Arbeidsvilkår 
Tiltreding snarast. Ørsta kommune vil vere arbeidsgjevar, med kontorplassering Ørsta rådhus, men stillinga er ein interkommunal ressurs og skal ha virkeområde i begge kommunane. 

Stillinga er plassert i HTA kap. 4.

Tilsetting skjer elles på dei vilkår og med dei rettar som går fram av gjeldande tariffavtalar og kommunale reglement.

Prøvetid
Prøvetid i faste stillingar er 6 mnd. I lengre vikariat er det høvesvis. Fråvær går til fråtrekk.

Intern søkjar
Dersom du ynskjer å bli vurdert ut frå kriterium for intern fortrinnsrett til stillinga, hakar du av på omsyn – intern søkjar. Dette gjeld berre for tilsette i Ørsta kommune som er ufrivillig deltids tilsett, har jobba i kommunen i til saman 12 månadar dei siste 2 åra, eller har andre faktorar knytt til lov- og avtaleverk som kan gi grunnlag for fortrinnsrett. jf AML §14.

Dokumentasjon 
Vitnemål/lenke til vitnemålsportalen og attestar frå tidlegare arbeidsforhold skal lastast opp i Webcruiter. Originale/bekrefta kopiar skal takast med til intervju. Vitnemål og attestar dannar grunnlaget for fastsetjing av ansiennitet og rett løn. Vi ber difor at du sender inn dokumentasjon på alle tidlegare arbeidsforhold. Attesten må innehalde dato frå-til, samt stillingsstørrelse eller antal timar.

Om offentleglova
Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil namnet ditt stå på ei offentleg søkarliste, i samsvar med offentleglova §25. Ønsker du å at namnet ditt skal vere unnateke frå den offentlege søkarlista, må du grunngje dette i søknadsskjemaet. Dersom kommunen meiner at det ikkje er grunnlag for fritak, vil du få beskjed og få tilbod om å trekkje søknaden før endeleg søkjarliste vert laga.
