title: Mechanical Technician
description:
The Data Center Engineer (Mechanical Equipment) will be responsible for ensuring the overall operation and maintenance of all cooling and associated mechanical / electrical / controls equipment within the nominated Datacenters. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. The Data Center Engineering Technician (Mechanical Equipment) will continue to maintain high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum, the engineer will drive innovation to reduce operational costs.

The Data Center Engineer (Mechanical Equipment) are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting for cooling equipment including Air Handling Units, Computer Room Air Handling Units and ancillary equipment initially, with scope to increase in the future to other mechanical infrastructure. They will plan, coordinate, manage and conduct preventative maintenance on assigned equipment. They will also identify root causes of faults, plan and deliver reactive and corrective maintenance.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

• Plan out, prepare sequence of operations and deliver preventative maintenance across all nominated Data Center sites.

• Identify, purchase and store spares and parts required for planned and reactive works.

• Conduct root cause analysis on failures and action remediation.

• Mentor and guide on site Engineering Operations Technicians unfamiliar with the equipment for immediate on site reaction during an event.

• Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance.

• Perform maintenance tasks to include: filter changes, tank inspections, legionella testing, pump maintenance.

• Perform first level trouble-shooting.

• Develop and implement risk assessments and method statements for works.

• Work on call or out of hours when required, though standard working arrangement will be Monday to Friday normal office hours.

• Take daily operational readings and provide to Senior Engineers for metrics reporting.

• Input and management of EAM for assigned assets.

• Update maintenance reports and planners.

• Perform basic support concepts such as ticketing systems, root cause analysis, and task prioritization.

Travel Between Data Center sites is involved

About the team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience within the mechanical equipment field. (Pumps, engines, cooling systems etc)

- Ability to travel between all nominated sites on a daily or weekly basis.

- EU Drivers license.

Preferred qualifications

- Particular experience in cooling systems (AHUs, CRAHUs, HVAC systems, Generators, Pumps, industrial water systems) is advantageous.

- Demonstrated capability in understanding and troubleshooting of cooling equipment and fundamentals.

- Training or certification in cooling systems a strong benefit.

title: Chief Engineer
description:
Amazon is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team . This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers.

Also expected from the CE is the ability to manage large scale impacting projects and new region support from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, procurement, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The CE directs, trains and supports EOTs in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities:

· Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in data centers

· Operate independently with limited direct management

· Assist in the design and build out of new facilities

· Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center region and work OT hours as needed to support site stability

· Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures

· Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA

· Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

· Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and assisting in recruiting efforts for the same

· Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

· Utilize internal Change Management Systems to manage building workflows

· MV/LV Isolation to facilitate MV maintenance

· Provide metric availability reporting on a weekly basis

· Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience

A day in the life

Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.

• Operate independently with limited direct management

• Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center

• Performing root cause analysis of equipment failures

• Troubleshooting and reporting of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA

• Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

• Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians

• Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

About the team

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic qualifications

Bachelors degree or higher in a mechanical/electrical engineering degree or similar technical/trade school completion (HVAC/electrician).

Preferred qualifications

- Meets/exceeds Amazon’s leadership principles requirements for this role

- Meets/exceeds Amazon’s functional/technical depth and complexity

- Previous data center operations/facilities experience

- Associates or Bachelors in applicable engineering field or mechanical or electrical trades

description:

We are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of data center infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems. You will be part of the Data Center Operations (DCO) team, overseeing the operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure and hardware for data centers in AWS Cloud regions. You will become the primary resolver for your support team, and gain troubleshooting skills on different hardware and software cases. You will be able to troubleshoot and solve most infrastructure issues and engage other appropriate solutions groups on more complex problems to drive solutions.

Key job responsibilities

This is a customer-facing role that requires strong technical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Your activities will include (but not limited to):

• Build relationships with internal teams and customers along with innovating effective solutions to meet issues & problems as they arise

• Conducting site assessments at various facilities to proactively prepare for the onsite installation of AWS equipment

• Installing/expanding/provisioning AWS infrastructure at the third-party premises, data center, and/or non-traditional environment

• Troubleshooting hardware, network installations & configurations and performing network testing, break/fix, rack installations and/or decommissioning and solving complex problems

• Proactively identifying and implementing strategies that prevent support issues and/or further enhance the customer experience

• Process and track purchase orders for data center hardware components

* Monitor spare parts inventory levels and initiate replenishment orders

* Track order approvals and provide timely updates to stakeholders

* Manage shipment label distribution for new equipment and returns

* Coordinate with global teams to ensure timely delivery and resolution of issue

• Required travel up to 25% on average. You will be required to travel between locations to install, service, and retrieve AWS equipment.

• Physical ability to push and/or pull heavy objects into position (regularly lift up to 18kg and participate in team lifts of 30 kg)

• May lead or participate in efforts to develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) and tools that improve operational efficiencies

• May lead larger projects that require cross-functional alignment and support, including large-DC installations, global-reaching business initiatives, and/or development of mechanisms to support growth to ensure compliance with global group standards.

• May be required to work at height to maintain AWS infrastructure equipment while adhering to AWS health & safety guidelines.

• Most of all, you will have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

About the team

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience

- Knowledge of fundamentals of hardware, networking, security, databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)

- 2+ years of leading large complex programs experience

- A valid (EU) driving license is required as Data Centers may not have any public transportation available nearby.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 4+ years of relevant technical position experience

- Experience working in a customer-facing environment

- CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Redhat), Hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications

title: Customer Service Engineer
description:
When joining PerkinElmer, you select an experienced and trusted leader in scientific solutions, with the support of a global service network and distribution centers, providing the right solution, at the right time, to meet critical customer needs.  With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services.

The Customer Service Engineer provides highly visible, on-site customer support through installation, preventive and remedial maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex laboratory equipment and systems. You will verify and approve the operational quality of system equipment, instruct customers on operation and maintenance, and act as the company's liaison on administrative and technical matters for assigned projects. This role spans system hardware, software, PCs, networking/wireless networking, and laboratory instrumentation.

It is a customer support role, not a research position, though scientific literacy is beneficial to understand lab processes.

Key Responsibilities

    Preventive and corrective maintenance: Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance to ensure uptime and compliance, documenting all work to quality standards.  
    Troubleshooting and diagnostics: Systematically diagnose issues on complex electro-mechanical instrumentation and associated software/controls; perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
    Installation and qualification: Install equipment and check out/approve operational quality; support IQ/OQ/PQ where applicable.
    Customer liaison: Serve as the primary interface with customer stakeholders on technical and administrative matters; interpret needs and coordinate with sales, customer support, or engineering as appropriate.
    Planning and coordination: Plan, schedule, and follow up with customers and suppliers on work status, parts availability, and timelines; ensure effective maintenance programs in a dynamic environment.
    Documentation and compliance: Maintain accurate service records, adhere to safety, GxP where applicable, and company/site policies.
    Knowledge sharing: Instruct end users on operation and maintenance; contribute to team know‑how and continuous improvement.
    Teamwork and autonomy: Work both independently and within small and large teams, taking personal responsibility for outcomes across a diverse instrument portfolio.

Equipment Portfolio Support will cover a wide range of laboratory systems, including:

    NMR, LC/MS and SFC systems
    Äkta system
    Tecan and other robot systems
    Freeze dryers (lyophilizers), rotary/roller evaporators, and vacuum pumps
    Centrifuges and balances/scales
    Clean/purified water systems
    Electro-mechanical subsystems with controls and rule-based fault correction, electronics, PCs, and networking/wireless networking

Candidate Profile Required:

    Relevant education in automation and/or a technical discipline, or equivalent years of maintenance/service experience in the technical industry
    Experience in the pharmaceutical or chemical industry
    Professional-level English
    Demonstrated team player mindset with a focus on daily delivery quality
    Alignment with PerkinElmer core values

Preferred/Advantageous

    Background in chemistry or related science
    Leadership experience (e.g., Team Leader, Supervisor)
    Continuous improvement experience (e.g., 5S, Lean)
    Coordination/planning and strong organizational skills
    Customer service experience

What We Offer

    Collaborative and supportive team environment
    Exposure to cutting-edge technologies
    Opportunity to support impactful scientific work
    Competitive compensation and benefits
    Ability to make a meaningful impact #ForTheBetter
    Professional development across a broad instrument landscape

Additional Information

    This is a hands-on service/maintenance technician role, not a research position; scientific literacy is advantageous.
    Roles based at our client site in Gothenburg require a drug test and background screening.
    All roles at PerkinElmer Sweden include a standard 6‑month probationary period.

title: QA/Tester
description:
Natural Cycles° is a leading women’s health company that developed the world’s first birth control app, used by millions globally. We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.

We are looking for a committed QA/Tester with a passion for quality and a keen eye for detail. You thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced, and agile environment, where you enjoy working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to build high-quality user experiences. You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by identifying risks, validating solutions, and providing quality insights that help teams make informed decisions.

As part of the Product Team, you will work on app features designed to support and guide users throughout their reproductive journey through AI tools, feedback loops, and personalised in-app content. You will also contribute to the Natural Cycles customer support chatbot, helping ensure a reliable, compliant, and high-quality experience across both user-facing and AI-powered features.

Please note that we are hiring for this role in Sweden.

What you will be doing

    

Design, execute, and document testing activities for new and updated features, prioritising test coverage based on customer impact, product risk, and regulatory requirements.

    

Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering throughout the development process, contributing to planning, requirements discussions, and feature validation to build quality into solutions from the start.

    

Identify quality risks, investigate defects, perform exploratory and regression testing, and provide timely, actionable feedback to support product and release decisions.

    

Maintain clear test evidence and medical device documentation, contributing to requirements reviews, risk assessments, and validation activities as needed.

    

Contribute to improvements in testing approaches, automation, tooling, and datasets to increase product quality, release confidence, and team effectiveness.

What skills and experience we think you have

    

2+ years of experience in QA and software testing within a cross-functional product development environment.

    

Experience designing, executing, and documenting test cases using functional, exploratory, regression, and risk-based testing techniques.

    

Hands-on experience testing one or more of the following: web applications, mobile applications, APIs, or applications integrating LLMs.

    

Proficiency with testing and debugging tools to investigate issues, analyse failures, and support defect resolution.

    

Experience contributing to automated testing and a solid understanding of modern software development practices, including version control, CI/CD, and release processes.

    

Strong communication, problem-solving, and organisational skills, with the ability to provide clear feedback, maintain documentation, and manage multiple priorities.

    

While not required, it is a plus if you have experience working in a regulated environment or with documentation-heavy quality processes.

What we offer

    

Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location

    

Professional development - you will collaborate with industry leading developers, promoting continuous growth and skill enhancement

    

Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work

    

Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value

    

Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development

Location

We are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person. Most of the Product team you will work with is located in Stockholm, and the team occasionally meets in the office for collaboration and face-to-face time.

Sounds interesting?

If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

How to apply

To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.

At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Note: We are not looking for consultants or help from recruitment agencies

title: Business Controller BU Fighter Core Capabilities
description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Be a co-pilot to the Product Unit Manager and program managers in financial matters

    

Actively work with increasing the financial focus within the product unit; highlight issues and propose action

    

Monitor and control financial aspects of product unit, programs and projects such as follow-up and analyze, prepare and report budgets and forecasts for the Product Unit´s P/L and BS

    

Analyze actuals and forecasts and initiate actions to improve financial performance

    

Take care of financial planning through forecasts, budgets and business plan

    

Work in close corporation with other controllers in the Finance function and actively participate and contribute to improvements and progress in processes, systems and control within the finance area

    

Be an active part in the Product Unit Management Team



As an employee at Saab you are part of creating a culture that enhances and promotes performance, innovation and transparency by coaching and developing others around you.



Your profile

title: Workplace Operations Coordinator (1 Years Contract)
description:

We are recruiting for a Workplace Services Coordinator to join our team in Stockholm for a 1 year contract. The Workplace Services Coordinator will provide essential customer service and operational coordination support across campus, serving as a key point of contact for employees and end users. This role manages fault reporting, coordinates reactive maintenance works, and ensures timely resolution of workplace issues through professional communication, excellent customer service and efficient coordination. Administration and reporting

    Support the Workplace Services Team Lead with performance metrics

This position is based at the client's premises in Kista, Stockholm. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, or 07:00 to 16:00, depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.



Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values - respect, integrity, service and excellence - and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Shape the Future of Tissue Technology as a Design Engineer

Are you ready for the next step in your engineering career? Join a highly skilled team in Karlstad where you will help design market-leading tissue machines used by customers around the world. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues throughout the delivery chain, turning customer needs into tailored technical solutions. You will have the opportunity to develop both your design expertise and your involvement in customer projects while contributing to innovative, sustainable industrial solutions.

Your responsibilities

    You will create detailed drawings and technical documentation that support purchasing, manufacturing, and assembly of tissue machines.
    You will collaborate with engineers, project managers, production teams, and pre-assembly functions to deliver high-quality customer solutions.
    You will contribute to the ongoing development, maintenance, and improvement of products, machine sections, and components.
    You will translate customer requirements into practical and effective mechanical design solutions.
    You will support customer projects from design through delivery and occasionally travel when required.

Expectations for you

    You hold a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or have equivalent experience in mechanical design.
    You have experience and a strong interest in mechanical product development and design engineering.
    You communicate confidently in written and spoken English.
    Experience from the paper, tissue, or process industry is considered a strong advantage.
    Some travel may be required as part of the role.

To succeed in this role

You enjoy combining technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and take ownership of your work from concept to delivery. Strong communication skills, problem-solving ability, and a structured approach will help you succeed in a role that involves close interaction with colleagues across engineering, production, and project teams. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve products and processes.

We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:

    Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
    Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
    Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
    Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer

You will join one of four engineering teams consisting of approximately 60 engineers working on world-leading tissue machine technology. The team combines expertise in mechanical design and technical project management, creating excellent opportunities for professional growth and knowledge sharing. As your experience grows, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of specific machine sections and components, becoming a key technical expert within your area. The role provides close collaboration with production and pre-assembly teams, giving you a valuable end-to-end understanding of the products you help create.

At Valmet, you'll work in an international and people-focused environment where innovation, sustainability, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do. We value continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional development, modern work tools, and a supportive culture where your ideas and contributions matter.

Want to know more?

Please send your application as soon as possible via the link provided, but no later than September 13. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Johan Stöllman, Manager Former Section, at johan.stollman@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.

Join the team – and lead the way with us!

title: Medarbetare inom aseptisk tillverkning
description:
At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.



BESKRIVNING AV TJÄNSTEN

Tjänsten innebär att du kommer att arbeta med tillverkning av medier, dvs. näringslösningar, för infertilitetsbehandlingar. Tillverkningen sker i renrum där flera manuella moment ingår i produktionsprocessen och produktkvalitet har högsta prioritet. Du kommer att arbeta både med manuella tillverkningssteg och hantera utrustning för aseptisk tillverkning, så som fyllningsmaskiner.

Du kommer att ingå i ett team av 10 personer och rapporterar direkt till produktionsledaren.

HUVUDSAKLIGA ARBETSUPPGIFTER

    

Vägning, beredning, fyllning, etikettering och packning av mediaprodukter

    

Renrumsstädning och miljöövervakning

    

Förbättringsarbete

Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning på ca 1 år.

VEM ÄR DU?

En av våra fyra värderingar är ”Quality that makes a difference” och det genomsyrar hela vår verksamhet, därför är det oerhört viktigt att du är en noggrann person med stor förståelse för vad kvaliteten innebär för våra produkter. I denna tjänst är det många moment som ställer höga krav på noggrannhet och kvalitetsförståelse, att kunna följa instruktioner samt ha mycket god fokuserings- och precisionsförmåga.

Då arbetet sker i renrum och i ett flöde tillsammans med dina kollegor är det viktigt att du tycker om att arbeta i grupp och att du är kommunikativ. Tjänsten innebär även en hel del samarbete med andra avdelningar. Du tycker också om att ta eget ansvar och är duktig på att se förbättringsmöjligheter.

Du har minst gymnasieutbildning, gärna med naturvetenskaplig inriktning. Erfarenhet av arbete i renrum är mycket meriterande. Det är också meriterande med tidigare erfarenhet från branscherna medicinteknik eller läkemedel. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift, är en förutsättning för tjänsten.

Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalized genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of fertility treatment.

We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Business Controller
description:

title: Project & Facilities Coordinator
description:
When joining PerkinElmer, you select an experienced and trusted leader in scientific solutions, with the support of a global service network and distribution centers, providing the right solution, at the right time, to meet critical customer needs.  With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services.

The Project & Facilities Coordinator provides highly visible, on-site customer support through installation, preventive and remedial maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex laboratory equipment and systems. You will verify and approve the operational quality of system equipment, instruct customers on operation and maintenance, and act as the company's liaison on administrative and technical matters for assigned projects. This role spans system hardware, software, PCs, networking/wireless networking, and laboratory instrumentation.

It is a customer support role, not a research position, though scientific literacy is beneficial to understand lab processes.

Key Responsibilities

    Preventive and corrective maintenance: Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance to ensure uptime and compliance, documenting all work to quality standards.

    Installation and qualification: Install equipment and check out/approve operational quality; support IQ/OQ/PQ where applicable.
    Customer liaison: Serve as the primary interface with customer stakeholders on technical and administrative matters; interpret needs and coordinate with sales, customer support, or engineering as appropriate.
    Planning and coordination: Plan, schedule, and follow up with customers and suppliers on work status, parts availability, and timelines; ensure effective maintenance programs in a dynamic environment.
    Documentation and compliance: Maintain accurate service records, adhere to safety, GxP where applicable, and company/site policies.
    Knowledge sharing: Instruct end users on operation and maintenance; contribute to team know‑how and continuous improvement.
    Teamwork and autonomy: Work both independently and within small and large teams, taking personal responsibility for outcomes across a diverse instrument portfolio.

Equipment Portfolio Support will cover a wide range of laboratory systems, including:

    NMR, LC/MS and SFC systems
    Äkta system
    Tecan and other robot systems
    Freeze dryers (lyophilizers), rotary/roller evaporators, and vacuum pumps
    Centrifuges and balances/scales
    Clean/purified water systems
    Electro-mechanical subsystems with controls and rule-based fault correction, electronics, PCs, and networking/wireless networking

Candidate Profile Required:

    Relevant education in automation and/or a technical discipline, or equivalent years of maintenance/service experience in the technical industry
    Experience in the pharmaceutical or chemical industry
    Professional-level English
    Demonstrated team player mindset with a focus on daily delivery quality
    Alignment with PerkinElmer core values

Preferred/Advantageous

    Background in chemistry or related science
    Leadership experience (e.g., Team Leader, Supervisor)
    Continuous improvement experience (e.g., 5S, Lean)
    Coordination/planning and strong organizational skills
    Customer service experience

What We Offer

    Collaborative and supportive team environment
    Exposure to cutting-edge technologies
    Opportunity to support impactful scientific work
    Competitive compensation and benefits
    Ability to make a meaningful impact #ForTheBetter
    Professional development across a broad instrument landscape

Additional Information

    This is a hands-on service/maintenance technician role, not a research position; scientific literacy is advantageous.

title: R&D Test Engineer
description:
🌱 About NitroCapt

NitroCapt is a climate-tech company electrifying one of the world’s largest chemical processes, the nitrogen fertilizer process, using air, water and renewable energy as the only input. The result is not only the most sustainable nitrogen fertilizers, but also the most cost efficient – a true revolution!

Our award-winning solution provides a quick transition into a decarbonized nitrogen fertilizer industry with a business model that makes our customers more profitable than continuing with fossil-based fertilizers.

Position summary

We are looking for a hands-on R&D Test Engineer with strong practical mechanical skills to work directly with our experimental and pilot-scale systems.

In this role, you will be responsible for operating, maintaining, and improving our pilot setup, ensuring reliable test execution and high-quality data collection.

This is a practical, equipment-focused role requiring strong hands-on mechanical competence and demonstrated experience working directly with industrial or experimental equipment.

Key Responsibilities

    

Prepare, operate and maintain experimental and pilot-scale process equipment.

    

Prepare, execute, and monitor test runs, manage data collection and documentation.

    

Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of process equipment including continues improvement of installation.

    

Track and manage spare parts, components, and equipment condition.

    

Ensure proper cleaning and readiness of systems between test campaigns.

    

Manage installation and improvement of equipment (mechanical, piping, connections, etc.)

    

Monitor and handle process components such as pumps, heat exchangers, valves, thermocouples, and pressure sensors.

    

Work with fluid systems (liquid/gas), including piping and connection elements.

    

Assist in diagnosing operational issues and improving system performance.

    

Collaborate closely with engineering and process teams during testing and development.

    

Ensure safety compliance.

    

Close collaboration with different internal and external stakeholders (e.g. R&D, engineering, suppliers and partners).

Qualifications & Experience

    

Technical education or experience (MSc or BSc with additional vocational training, or equivalent experience in mechanical engineering, industrial maintenance, mechatronics, automation, manufacturing, or a closely related technical field).

    

Minimum 3 years of experience working in a test/pilot production environment.

    

Hands-on experience with one or more of the following process areas is of merit: Chemical processes, Radio systems, Mechanical design and manufacturing, high or low voltage systems, PLC programming.

    

Excellent English skills (both written and oral). Proficiency in Swedish language is a plus.

    

Highly hands-on and practical mindset, comfortable working directly with process equipment.

    

Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility.

    

Able to work independently while maintaining good communication with the team.

    

Strong problem-solving skills in operational and experimental environments.

    

Detail-oriented, with a structured approach to work.

    

Comfortable following procedures, safety rules, and operational standards.

    

Willing and able to document work accurately, including test results and equipment status.

    

Organized and disciplined in maintaining equipment, workspace, and records.

    

Align with our team principles: PACE – Persistent, Active, Collaborative, and Evolving.

What we Offer

    

A unique engineering challenge that has good chances to have a huge impact on the industry and global environment.

    

To be part of a dynamic, purpose-driven, international team.

    

An innovative entrepreneurial environment with possibilities to set your own and the company’s working processes and have a great influence.

    

To work closely with some of Europe’s best researchers and engineers in our fields, in projects coordinated by NitroCapt.

    

A generous option program, allowing to take part of a future economic growth.

    

6 weeks paid vacation per year.

    

Occupational pension & Wellness benefit.

title: Postdoc in Energy Engineering
description:
The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Engineering Sciences brings together a large part of the University’s Bachelor of Science in Engineering and Master of Science in Engineering programmes in fields such as energy engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, building engineering, environmental engineering and industrial systems. The department conducts internationally recognised research focusing on future energy and industrial systems. Collaboration with industry and society is central to developing sustainable, resource-efficient and competitive solutions for the society of tomorrow.

Employment information

Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years

Period of employment/Start date: By agreement

Scope: Full time

Number of positions: 1

Closing date for application: 3 September 2026

Campus location: Västerås

School: Department of Engineering Sciences

Position description

The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years.

The main responsibility of this position is to contribute to research projects focusing on modelling, optimization, control, and AI applications for smart buildings. The work includes collaboration with international research and industrial partners, publication of scientific articles, and responsibility for the implementation and reporting of project activities.

The position may include teaching activities corresponding to up to 20% of full-time employment within the areas of energy engineering, building engineering, or environmental engineering.

Qualification requirements

The applicant is required to have a PhD degree in energy engineering, building engineering, mechanical engineering, or other relevant technical fields relevant to the position. The applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.

Applicants must be able to demonstrate knowledge and experience in:

    Simulation software for building and district energy systems, both commercial and open-source;
    Optimization of building energy consumption, both electrical and thermal;
    Modelling, optimization and/or control of either buildings or energy systems;
    Programming in Python, MATLAB, or similar.

Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.

Assessment criteria

Particular emphasis will be placed on knowledge and experience in:

    Participation in international projects involving academic and industrial partners;
    Electrification of the heating sector and the interaction between heating and electrical systems;
    Modelling, optimization, analysis and/or control of renewable energy technologies and energy storage technologies in buildings;
    AI methods applied to building or energy systems;

title: Cloud Architect
description:

title: PhD Student in Mining and Rock Engineering
description:
PhD Student in Mining and Rock Engineering with special focus on underground hydrogen storage



Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.



Luleå University of Technology, together with the Geological Survey of Sweden (SGU) and several Swedish industrial partners, is launching a multidisciplinary research project on natural hydrogen resources and underground hydrogen storage.



We are seeking a motivated PhD candidate in Mining and Rock Engineering to contribute to interdisciplinary research spanning rock engineering, geophysics, geology and energy systems. The project offers a unique opportunity to work with leading researchers and industry partners while addressing one of the key technological challenges of the energy transition.



As a doctoral student at Luleå University of Technology, you will receive excellent supervision, access to advanced research facilities, and opportunities to develop into an internationally recognized researcher.



Subject description

Mining and Rock Engineering comprises mining technology, rock engineering and rock mechanics, including rock mass properties, design of rock excavations and tunneling as well as planning and production processes related to both mining and civil engineering.



Project description

For this PhD position, the research will focus on the development of engineered underground hydrogen storage in lined rock caverns (LRCs) excavated in hard crystalline rock. Your tasks are to:

- develop coupled thermo-hydro-mechanical numerical models to simulate hydrogen injection, storage and withdrawal;

- evaluate the effects of operational loading on the integrity of steel liners, concrete and surrounding rock;

- develop reference designs for lined rock caverns of different storage capacities together with scaling methodologies;

- assess site-specific performance under different geological conditions and providing design recommendations for future demonstration projects.



The project is carried out in close collaboration between Luleå University of Technology, the Geological Survey of Sweden (SGU), and several Swedish industrial partners. The successful candidate will work closely with researchers specializing in rock mechanics, underground construction, geophysics and geology, while interacting regularly with industrial stakeholders.



Duties

As a PhD student, you will:

- conduct independent research through numerical modelling, laboratory testing and field investigations;

- participate in site investigations and data collection in northern Sweden;

- develop methodologies for evaluating suitable storage sites and optimized lined rock cavern designs;

- publish research findings in leading international scientific journals;

- present research at national and international conferences;

- complete doctoral coursework required for the degree.



The majority of your working time will be devoted to doctoral research. Depending on departmental needs, you may also have the opportunity to gain experience in teaching and supervision.



You will become a member of the Network of Young Scientists (NYS) within CH2ESS, which organizes workshops, field excursions, interdisciplinary networking activities and professional development events.



Qualifications

Applicants must hold an MSc degree (or equivalent) in one of the following areas:

- Rock Mechanics

- Civil Engineering (with specialization in geotechnical engineering or underground construction)

- Mining Engineering

- Solid Mechanics

- or a closely related discipline



A strong background in numerical modelling of rock and underground structures is essential. Experience with finite element, finite difference or discrete element modelling (e.g., FLAC3D, 3DEC, Abaqus, COMSOL or similar software) is considered an advantage.



The successful candidate should demonstrate:

- strong analytical and problem-solving skills;

- enthusiasm for scientific research;

- ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams;

- excellent communication skills in written and spoken English.



Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage because some fieldwork, industrial interaction and teaching activities may require communication in Swedish, but it is not a mandatory requirement.



For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en



Further information

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. The expected start date for the position is October-December 2026.



For each position, a preliminary salary range https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

    We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
    

    We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
    

    We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Creative Director to own the creative bar at Legora — sitting at the intersection of brand and marketing, and making sure everything we put into the world looks, sounds, and feels like one company with one point of view.

Legora's brand is one of our sharpest differentiators in a category that mostly looks and sounds the same. This role exists to protect that edge and scale it: setting the visual and verbal identity, translating it into campaigns that drive pipeline, and raising the craft bar across every team that touches creative output — brand, product marketing, growth, and events.

The ideal candidate has spent close to a decade building and running creative for ambitious brands, moving fluidly between the strategic (what should this brand stand for, and why) and the hands-on (what does this campaign, page, or deck actually look like). They know how to hold a high bar without becoming a bottleneck, and how to make craft a competitive advantage rather than a nice-to-have.

What You'll Do

Brand identity: Set the standard for Legora's visual and verbal identity— ensuring consistency and distinctiveness across every surface, from product to campaigns to partnerships.

Creative direction: Set the creative vision for major campaigns and launches, translating positioning and strategy into work that's sharp, memorable, and on-brand.

Cross-functional partnership: Sitting within the Brand team, work closely across all parts of Marketing and across other parts of the organisation to make sure external content and creative output serves both brand-building and pipeline goals.

Team and process: Build and lead a small, high-craft creative function — whether that's in-house talent, freelancers, or agency partners — and put a review process in place that raises the bar without slowing the team down.

Campaign creative: Direct creative for integrated campaigns, launches, and partnerships (including high-profile brand partnerships), from concept through execution.

Design systems: Together with the Head of Design, maintain and extend Legora's design systems and brand guidelines so the identity scales cleanly as the company grows.

Storytelling: Push Legora's creative work beyond category convention — legal tech doesn't have to look or sound like legal tech.

What You Bring

    8+ years in creative roles spanning brand and marketing, with real experience owning creative direction end-to-end
    

    A portfolio that shows range — brand systems, campaign creative, and the strategic thinking that connects them
    

    Experience building or scaling a creative function, including managing designers, writers, and external partners
    

    Comfort operating at both altitudes: setting brand strategy and getting hands-on with the work when it matters
    

    A sharp eye and the conviction to defend it — you can explain why a piece of work is right, not just that it feels right
    

    Experience in high-growth B2B or enterprise environments; AI, tech, or professional services a plus
    

    Operates with conviction in ambiguous environments and doesn't need a large support structure to produce great work

What's In It For You

Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America.

Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.

Meaningful work: Your creative direction shapes how thousands of lawyers experience Legora.

In-person environment: An office designed for ambitious builders, with company-provided lunch daily.

Benefits & Perks: We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Grabs

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Tipp: Laufend neue [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Bewerben Sie sich deshalb jetzt als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Grabs. Wir vermitteln schnell und persönlich, denn gute Fachkräfte verdienen ebenso gute Partner.

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Kaiseraugst liegt strategisch günstig im Kanton Aargau nahe Basel und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Basel und das Dreiländereck machen die Region für Arbeitnehmende äußerst attraktiv, da Sie von einer stabilen Wirtschaft und vielfältigen Jobmöglichkeiten profitieren. ### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Chaque journée est différente : accompagnement social et administratif, accès aux droits, coordination avec nos partenaires\- un travail riche et porteur de sens.  
Vous rejoindrez une équipe pluridisciplinaire et solidaire, où entraide et partage d'expérience sont essentiels.  
Nous cherchons une personne motivée, prête à s'engager pour la et le respect de la dignité humaine.  
Au plaisir de faire votre connaissance ».

Vous êtes en charge du suivi administratif et entretiens sociaux.  
Vous mettez en place un plan d'action personnalisés.

Vous avez bachelor HES en travail social (reconnaissance SEFRI si diplôme étranger).

Un environnement de travail engagé  
5 semaines de vacances (6 dès 50 ans)  
De très bonnes prestations sociales  
Des projets porteurs de sens dans un contexte interculturel stimulant

1\. Un entretien avec le responsable d'antenne et la chargée de recrutement.

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience
